verses.pali: rūpaṁ ‘netaṁ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassathā”ti?
verses.english: Do you regard form like this: ‘This is not mine, I am not this, this is not my self’?”

verses.pali: Rūpaṁ, bhikkhave, ‘netaṁ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṁ yathābhūtaṁ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṁ.
verses.english: Form should be truly seen with right understanding like this: ‘This is not mine, I am not this, this is not my self.’

verses.pali: viññāṇaṁ ‘netaṁ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassathā”ti?
verses.english: consciousness like this: ‘This is not mine, I am not this, this is not my self’?”

verses.pali: Viññāṇaṁ, bhikkhave, ‘netaṁ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṁ yathābhūtaṁ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṁ …
verses.english: Consciousness should be truly seen with right understanding like this: ‘This is not mine, I am not this, this is not my self.’
They understand: ‘… there is nothing further for this place.’”
